name: omni-code
description: Omni — a fast, transparent AI code editor

scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
scripts.desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run start --workspace=desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist:linux --workspace=desktop
